header: Legal links as one separated line
text: Leave the heading empty and the bar reads as a single line; the nav then takes its accessible name from a translated default instead of from a heading that is not there.
note: The rules between the links are drawn by the stylesheet. Typed into the labels they would end up in a copied line and in what a screen reader reads out.

links.title: Two to ten links
links.description: The description becomes the link's title attribute

links.title: Below 480px the rules go
